root_cause: Some business errors carried errorKey without statusCode. server.mjs only used error.statusCode, so provider_config_not_found degraded to HTTP 500.

details: Resolve public error key from error.errorKey before error.message.
Map known provider/task business keys to their contract status codes.
Use the resolved public key for response classification and message lookup.

verification.result: blocked by invalid external REAL_ADMIN credentials; no server 500 observed during this rerun

known_limitations: Playwright live Web run requires valid REAL_ADMIN_ID and REAL_ADMIN_CREDENTIAL for the running fixture service.
